description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the FormatWithPayGradeId class within the OrangeHRM project. It sets up test data, mocks necessary services, and includes test methods to verify the behavior of the formatting functionality related to pay grade IDs.

classes.name: FormatWithPayGradeIdTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the FormatWithPayGradeId class, verifying correctness of formatted pay grade values.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures, including loading test data from a YAML file and setting up the object under test.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests the getFormattedValue method to ensure it returns the expected formatted string for a valid pay grade ID and null for an invalid ID.
